cohort: Pregnant women who delivered after successful ECV (n=198) compared to the next two women with spontaneous cephalic presentation, matched for delivery date, maternal age, parity, BMI, and delivery history (1996-2015)
finding: Women who have a successful ECV are at increased risk of caesarean section compared with women who experience spontaneous cephalic presentation.
mod_finding: Caesarean section for abnormal fetal head position (forehead, bregma, face) was higher after successful ECV (28.6% versus 0%).
